crossRefs.note: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good…

translations.web: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.
translations.bsb: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
translations.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
translations.asv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.
